$comment: The upstream projects whose sources this checkout builds. setup.py --build compiles src/ (Strata's engine) and src/poly (PolyStrata) from this tree, so a build is only as new as the last merge into it: write that merge here, in the same commit. tools/upstream_status.py --check reads both projects' release feeds and says what they have released since. A merge moves the tag and the commit together; the paths are what the merge brought in, kept apart from this fork's own code (the AQ3 kernels and the aryainfer target live in src/poly too).
